correctness.rationale: Direct group-law computation and character-orthogonality derive rank-s spectral coefficients q^{2(a+b-s)}. Subspace Möbius inversion evaluates every rank character sum, giving the exact normalized q^{2kab-ab} prefactor. Every central target and every prime-power characteristic is covered. Matrix rank subadditivity and a rank-factorization pairing prove exactly ceil(r/2) commutators. A standalone exhaustive checker covers 9 small one-step configurations and 4 multi-step configurations, all prescribed matrices, including F4 extension arithmetic. Finite tests support rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: Uniformly computes full prescribed-target distributions of arbitrary products of commutator words in natural finite class-two graph groups, plus exact sharp elementwise commutator length and its rank distribution. This natural infinite-family invariant refines class-size counts and makes precise the transition between one and several commutators. The method yields tractable integer Gaussian sums and reproducible tests; significance is structural rather than an arbitrary small numerical improvement.
